description:
Five Star Linemen Academy is led by Pass Rush and Defensive Line Specialist Coach Arpedge Rolle, delivering high-level training for serious athletes who want to dominate in the trenches. This channel is dedicated to teaching elite defensive line techniques, fundamentals, and game-ready drills designed to elevate your performance at every level of the game.

Whether you're just starting out or already competing at a high level, you’ll gain access to detailed breakdowns of pass rush moves, hand placement, footwork, leverage, block destruction, and overall defensive line IQ. Every video is built to help you train with purpose, develop consistency, and translate your work directly onto the field.

If you're ready to sharpen your skills, increase your explosiveness, and become a more complete defensive lineman, you're in the right place. Train smarter. Play faster. Dominate the line of scrimmage.

Welcome to Five Star Linemen Academy, where you learn to train like a DAWG. LET'S GO TO WORK!
